status: retrospective exploratory analysis; frozen before validation fits, not preregistered
train_split: first floor(2 J/3) archive-numbered jobs; final third held out
joint_objective: sum of mean squared full-table probability residuals, equal weight per acquisition
confidence: 95% simultaneous two-table spectral lower bounds conditional on mutually independent shots; separate independent-job sensitivity is conservative and generally vacuous
reported_optimizer_results: feasible upper bounds only; no Wilks p-values, global optima or continuous theta confidence intervals
calibration_transfer: none, including the two Nairobi epochs
leakage_cap_interpretation: sensitivity choices, not independently measured calibration limits
